featuredFeature.name: Magic Prospections
featuredFeature.headline: Find targeted prospects for your exact freelance dev expertise
featuredFeature.description: Magic Prospections is Retainr's upcoming prospection and lead generation tool for freelance developers. It helps identify targeted companies, match them to your technical expertise, prepare cold outreach angles, and move promising replies into your Retainr client workflow.
bullets: Target prospects by niche, technology stack, business type, and service fit
Generate cold email angles for your specific freelance development expertise
Track outreach, replies, and follow-up status before a lead becomes a client
Move warm prospects into Retainr signup, onboarding, billing, and delivery
featuredFeature.note: Available first on the Magic Prospections plan as the lead-generation layer for dev freelancers who want more qualified conversations.

faq.question: Will the mobile app have my agency or brand name?
faq.answer: Yes. Your branded app can carry your logo and brand name across the App Store and Play Store experience.

faq.question: Can I add unlimited clients?
faq.answer: Yes. Retainr is built for unlimited clients and a clear team structure based on your plan.

faq.question: Is it easy to add and sell services?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a service package, set payment details, publish the offer, and send clients directly to the right signup flow.

faq.question: Who owns the data, customers, and subscribers?
faq.answer: You do. Your client data, customers, orders, and subscribers belong to your business.

faq.question: Do you integrate with Zapier and Google Analytics?
faq.answer: Yes. Retainr includes webhook and API options so you can connect your agency stack and automate the work around delivery.
